 "rationale": "Ideal R/C set fc, so it does not move with PVT. With Q=0.6 there is no peaking, and attenuation at 10*fc is about 36 dB, well above 19 dB. The OTA is NMOS-input because the PMOS |Vth| is too high at VCM=0.9 V. GBW target is about 1 MHz, roughly 25x f0. Current budget: IREF + 30 uA tail, giving about 80 uW at 1.98 V."}

PARAMS = {
    "gmid_in": (17.0, 12.0, 22.0),       # input pair: weak/moderate inversion -> low Vgs, high gm
    "L_in":    (0.5, 0.3, 1.5),
    "itail":   (30e-6, 12e-6, 50e-6),
    "gmid_p":  (11.0, 7.0, 14.0),        # PMOS mirror load
    "L_p":     (1.0, 0.5, 2.0),
    "gmid_t":  (13.0, 9.0, 16.0),        # tail / bias mirror
    "R":       (200e3, 80e3, 400e3),
    "fc_t":    (34.5e3, 32e3, 37e3),
    "Q":       (0.6, 0.52, 0.66),
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6)
    cl = spec.get("cl", 10e-12)
    vcm = spec.get("vcm", 0.9)
    it = p["itail"]; ih = it / 2
    Lt = 1.0

    # ---- OTA devices ----
    min_ = lut.size("n", p["gmid_in"], p["L_in"], ih, vds=0.5)
    vtail = vcm - min_.vgs
    mt = lut.size("n", p["gmid_t"], Lt, it, vds=max(vtail, 0.15))
    mb = lut.size("n", p["gmid_t"], Lt, iref, vds=mt.vgs)          # ibias diode
    mp = lut.size("p", p["gmid_p"], p["L_p"], ih, vds=0.9)

    # ---- Sallen-Key passives (R1=R2=R, C1 feedback, C2 to ground) ----
    Q = p["Q"]; R = p["R"]
    # fc/f0 for 2nd-order LP with given Q
    a = 1/Q**2 - 2
    u = (-a + math.sqrt(a*a + 4)) / 2
    k = math.sqrt(u)                       # fc = k*f0
    f0 = p["fc_t"] / k
    w0 = 2*PI*f0
    csq = 1/(w0*R)                         # sqrt(C1*C2)
    ratio = (2*Q)**2                       # C1/C2
    C2 = csq / math.sqrt(ratio)
    C1 = csq * math.sqrt(ratio)

    n = Netlist("vin vout vdd vss ibias")
    # bias
    n.dev("MB", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mb)
    n.dev("MT", "tail", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mt)
    # diff pair: + input = n2, - input = vout (unity-gain follower)
    n.dev("M1", "d1", "n2", "tail", "vss", min_)
    n.dev("M2", "vout", "vout", "tail", "vss", min_) if False else n.dev("M2", "vout", "vout", "tail", "vss", min_)
    n.dev("M3", "d1", "d1", "vdd", "vdd", mp)
    n.dev("M4", "vout", "d1", "vdd", "vdd", mp)
    # filter
    n.R("R1", "vin", "n1", R)
    n.R("R2", "n1", "n2", R)
    n.C("C1", "n1", "vout", C1)
    n.C("C2", "n2", "vss", C2)

    # ---- predictions ----
    gm = min_.gm
    rout = 1/(min_.gds + mp.gds)
    A = gm*rout
    gain_db = db(A/(1+A))
    gbw = gm/(2*PI*(cl + C1*0.5 + mp.cdd + min_.cdd))
    fc = k*f0
    x = 10*fc/f0
    atten = 10*math.log10((1-x*x)**2 + (x/Q)**2)
    peaking = 0.0 if Q <= 1/math.sqrt(2) else db(Q/math.sqrt(1-1/(4*Q*Q)))
    power = 1.8*(iref + it)
    return n, {"fc": fc, "atten_db": atten, "peaking_db": peaking,
               "gain_db": gain_db, "power": power, "gbw": gbw}
